sources: https://www.campspot.com/book/shoal-creek-campground (Campspot API, park 94: availability for 2026-11-10, 2026-11-14, 2027-05-15, 2027-06-15 and type quotes for 'Lake-view site W/E (RV)' and 'Lake-front site W/E (RV)'), read 2026-10-30 in headless Chromium

values.note: Site charge before fees and tax: lake-view water/electric RV site $40 on a November 2026 weeknight, $45 on a June 2027 weeknight; lake-front RV site $45-50 weeknights and $55 a night on a May 2027 weekend. Campspot adds a $2 'Reservation Surcharge' per stay and a ~3% credit-card processing fee. Tent sites $27.75-43.20. Late check-out $20.

fees.source: Campspot type quotes for park 94: 'Lake-view site W/E (RV)' 2026-11-10 averagePricePerNight 43.20 incl. campground fees 3.20 ('Credit Card Processing Fee' 1.20, 'Reservation Surcharge' 2.00), 2027-06-15 48.35 incl. 3.35; 'Lake-front site W/E (RV)' 2027-06-15 53.50 incl. 3.50, 2027-05-14..16 averagePricePerNightBeforeTaxesAndFees 55.0; operator rules ('Late check-out fee is $20'), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: Campspot site amenities ('50-Amp', 'Water Hook-Up' on the W/E RV sites) + https://www.shoalcreekcampground.com/general-campground-information ('There are no sewer hook-ups on any sites at Shoal Creek'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 59 water/electric RV sites (31 lake-front, 28 lake-view), 54 of them listed for rigs of 23 ft or more (to 40 ft); sites 56, 57, 74, 77 (20 ft) and 71 (22 ft) are shorter. All back-in. Also 56 tent sites. One RV and two vehicles per site, 6 people max.

sites.source: Campspot availability (each site's rvInfo rvLengthMax and rvTypes incl. 'Motorhome'; amenities 'Back-In'; no pull-through amenity) + https://www.shoalcreekcampground.com/general-campground-information ('one RV and two vehicles per assigned site'; 'MAXIMUM of 6 people'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Boat ramp (registered campers only), swim area. Generators prohibited.

facilities.source: https://www.shoalcreekcampground.com/about ('Restrooms & Showers', 'Dump Station', 'Boat Ramp', 'Swim Area') + general information ('PROHIBITED: Generators'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Campspot, not recreation.gov; June 2027 was already bookable on 2026-10-30. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 1 pm. Cancel 14+ days out for a refund less $10.

booking.source: Campspot availability ('There is a 2 night minimum over the requested period of time' on Saturdays 2026-11-14 and 2027-05-15, none on Tuesdays; 2027-06-15 AVAILABLE) + https://www.shoalcreekcampground.com/general-campground-information ('Check-in time is 2:00 pm Check-out time is 1:00 pm'; cancellation policy), read 2026-10-30

note: USACE Lake Lanier land leased to and operated by Lanier Islands (Margaritaville at Lanier Islands) as a concession; seven miles from the resort. Wooded and lakefront sites spread over a forested peninsula. --Claude
summary: Campspot quotes (motorhome allowed; no van/motorhome split) change fees $43.20-48.35 (fee-inclusive averages) -> $40-55 site charge (lake-view $40 Nov 2026 weeknight to lake-front $55 May 2027 weekend), reservation_fee $2 per stay. 50-amp + water, no sewer (operator), showers + dump, year-round (operator), 2-night weekend minimum. Sites: 59 W/E RV sites (54 take 23 ft+, max 40, all back-in) + 56 tent. Pin sits inside the campground peninsula (north part), kept. Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT re-audit lead: stored 'lakeview', but Campspot sells 31 of the 59 RV sites as 'Lake-front site W/E (RV)' and the Campspot site map draws many pads along the peninsula shoreline. Re-audit from the pads.
